title: B and A seesaw
story: B sits high, A sits low, and the garden seesaw rocks between them.
childCue: Play B, A, B, A. Move only finger 2.
adultCue: Keep the recorder still and watch the second finger move from its large knuckle rather than the whole hand.
successCue: The seesaw made four gentle trips!
tips: Slow changes are still good changes.
